who: OneLiteFeather is a Minecraft network that lives on its community – and on people who love to build, play and develop. Founded in 2021 as OneLiteFeather, we have been growing step by step ever since: with our own game modes, community builds and software that we share openly.

pillars.title: Building together
pillars.text: Builds like Yggdrasil or the Maze are created by the community. We provide the schematics so you can rebuild them yourself.

pillars.title: Built by us, shared openly
pillars.text: We release plugins like Anti-RedstoneClock Remastered and projects like Otis as open source – other servers benefit from them too.

pillars.title: Events with a signature of their own
pillars.text: From build events to game modes of our own such as Slender, which we brought to Minecraft in 2023.

pillars.title: Infrastructure that holds up
pillars.text: We run our infrastructure ourselves and write about it openly – for example in the blog on cluster resilience and automation.

work: No pay-to-win. We are funded by voluntary donations on OpenCollective – every income and expense is publicly visible there. Supporters receive the Lite rank as a thank-you, but no gameplay advantage.
join: Join the server, drop by on Discord or apply to the team – we are always looking for people who want to build something.
